# Newsweek
> Newsweek is a digital news magazine covering breaking news, analysis, and reporting across U.S., world, politics, business, technology, sports, and lifestyle.

Newsweek publishes daily reporting, explainers, opinion, fact checks, topic pages, and special coverage on major geopolitical, economic, and cultural developments. Its site is organized around core news desks, recurring topic hubs, and verticals such as personal finance, autos, and workplace reporting.

## Core News
- [Homepage](https://www.newsweek.com): Main entry point for breaking news, featured stories, analysis, and video.
- [News](https://www.newsweek.com/news): General news coverage spanning major current events and developing stories.
- [U.S.](https://www.newsweek.com/us): National news focused on U.S. events, policy, crime, and public affairs.
- [World](https://www.newsweek.com/world): International reporting on conflicts, diplomacy, and global developments.
- [Politics](https://www.newsweek.com/politics): Coverage of elections, government, legislation, and political strategy.

## World & Geopolitics
- [Russia-Ukraine](https://www.newsweek.com/topic/russia): Topic hub for Russia, Ukraine, war coverage, and regional geopolitics.
- [Middle East](https://www.newsweek.com/topic/middle-east): Reporting and analysis on conflicts, diplomacy, and regional affairs.
- [China and Asia](https://www.newsweek.com/topic/china): Coverage of China, Asia-Pacific developments, and international relations.
- [World](https://www.newsweek.com/world): Broader international news archive across regions and global issues.
- [News](https://www.newsweek.com/news): General reporting that often includes major geopolitical and security stories.

## Politics & Public Affairs
- [Politics](https://www.newsweek.com/politics): Central politics desk for campaigns, Congress, the White House, and policy.
- [U.S.](https://www.newsweek.com/us): Domestic reporting with strong focus on government and civic issues.
- [Fact Check](https://www.newsweek.com/fact-check): Verification of political claims, viral narratives, and public statements.
- [News](https://www.newsweek.com/news): Breaking developments relevant to governance, law, and public affairs.

## Technology & Innovation
- [Technology](https://www.newsweek.com/technology): Tech news covering AI, platforms, devices, cybersecurity, and industry shifts.
- [News](https://www.newsweek.com/news): General reporting that includes major technology and science developments.
- [Fact Check](https://www.newsweek.com/fact-check): Verification of viral technology claims and online misinformation.

## Money, Work & Industry
- [Personal Finance](https://www.newsweek.com/personal-finance): Consumer finance coverage on taxes, retirement, debt, and benefits.
- [Better Workplaces](https://www.newsweek.com/better-workplaces): Reporting on workplace culture, leadership, hiring, and employer trends.
- [Autos](https://www.newsweek.com/autos): Automotive news, industry developments, and vehicle-related reporting.
- [Technology](https://www.newsweek.com/technology): Business-relevant technology coverage affecting markets and workplaces.

## Fact Checking & Verification
- [Fact Check](https://www.newsweek.com/fact-check): Dedicated fact-checking section for rumors, images, quotes, and claims.
- [Politics](https://www.newsweek.com/politics): Political reporting frequently linked with verification and context.
- [News](https://www.newsweek.com/news): Breaking stories where verified updates and sourcing are essential.

## Sports
- [Sports](https://www.newsweek.com/sports): Sports news, commentary, athlete coverage, and major event reporting.
- [U.S.](https://www.newsweek.com/us): National stories that may intersect with sports culture and public issues.
- [News](https://www.newsweek.com/news): General coverage including major sports-related headlines and developments.

## Lifestyle & Family
- [Lifestyle](https://www.newsweek.com/life): Lifestyle features covering health, culture, relationships, and everyday living.
- [Family & Parenting](https://www.newsweek.com/topic/parenting): Topic page for parenting advice, family trends, and related features.
- [Better Planet](https://www.newsweek.com/better-planet): Sustainability and environmental lifestyle reporting.
- [News](https://www.newsweek.com/news): General-interest stories that overlap with culture and lifestyle topics.

## Special Topics
- [Russia-Ukraine](https://www.newsweek.com/topic/russia): Ongoing topic coverage of Russia, Ukraine, and related military developments.
- [Middle East](https://www.newsweek.com/topic/middle-east): Topic archive for Middle East conflicts, diplomacy, and regional politics.
- [China and Asia](https://www.newsweek.com/topic/china): Topic archive for China-focused reporting and Asia regional coverage.
- [Family & Parenting](https://www.newsweek.com/topic/parenting): Topic archive for parenting-related stories and family life coverage.

## Site Sections
- [News](https://www.newsweek.com/news): Main archive for broad news reporting and breaking developments.
- [U.S.](https://www.newsweek.com/us): National desk archive for domestic reporting and analysis.
- [World](https://www.newsweek.com/world): International desk archive for global stories and regional coverage.
- [Politics](https://www.newsweek.com/politics): Politics archive for elections, policy, and government news.
- [Technology](https://www.newsweek.com/technology): Technology archive for innovation, digital culture, and industry news.
- [Personal Finance](https://www.newsweek.com/personal-finance): Finance archive for consumer money guidance and economic updates.
- [Autos](https://www.newsweek.com/autos): Automotive archive for cars, mobility, and industry reporting.
- [Sports](https://www.newsweek.com/sports): Sports archive for leagues, athletes, and event coverage.
- [Life](https://www.newsweek.com/life): Lifestyle archive for culture, health, and human-interest features.
